These exercises exercise a broader range of SymPy parsing and equivalence
checking. Unless a stricter mode or form is requested, any algebraically
equivalent expression is accepted.

## Polynomial algebra

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-expand
#| vars: x
Expand $(2x-3)(x+4)$: __[2*x^2+5*x-12]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-factor
#| vars: x
#| form: factored
Factor $x^3-4x$: __[x*(x-2)*(x+2)]
```

## Rational expressions

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-rational
#| vars: x
#| form: single_fraction
Write $\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{x+1}$ as one fraction:
__[(2*x+1)/(x*(x+1))]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-lowest-terms
#| form: lowest_terms
Reduce $84/126$ fully: _[2/3]
```

## Powers, roots, and constants

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-radicals
Simplify $\sqrt{72}$: _[6*sqrt(2)]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-logarithm
#| vars: x
Differentiate $\log(x^2)$ formally: __[2/x]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-exponential
#| vars: x
Differentiate $e^{3x}$: __[3*exp(3*x)]
```

## Trigonometry

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-trig-identity
#| vars: x
Simplify $\sin^2(x)+\cos^2(x)$: _[1]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-trig-value
Give the exact value of $\sin(\pi/6)$: _[1/2]
```

## Derivatives and integrals

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-derivative
#| vars: x
Differentiate $x^2\sin(x)$:
__[2*x*sin(x)+x^2*cos(x)]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-antiderivative
#| vars: x
Give one antiderivative of $3x^2-4$: __[x^3-4*x]
```

## Complex numbers

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-complex
Compute $(1+2i)(3-i)$ using `I` for $i$: __[5+5*I]
```

## Solution sets

Order does not matter in `set` mode, and repeated items are compared as a
multiset.

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-roots-set
#| mode: set
List all roots of $x^3-x=0$: __[-1,0,1]
```

## Numerical checking

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-absolute-tolerance
#| mode: numeric
#| tolerance: 0.001
Approximate $\sqrt{2}$: _[sqrt(2)]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-relative-tolerance
#| mode: numeric
#| tolerance: 1%
Approximate $e^5$: _[exp(5)]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-decimal-places
#| mode: numeric
#| decplaces: 3
Give $\pi$ to three decimal places: _[pi]
```

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-significant-figures
#| mode: numeric
#| sigfigs: 4
Give $1/7$ to four significant figures: _[1/7]
```

## Exact representation

```{math-exercise}
#| label: sympy-exact
#| mode: exact
#| vars: x
Enter the canonical expanded expression $x^2+2x+1$:
__[x^2+2*x+1]
```
